objective: Measure candidate coverage under an enforced public-data deadline; separately score exact predictions and common processed outputs.
hardware: Four L4 workers per notebook, pinned upstream image and model
primary_outcomes: number of queued, started, trained, fully decoded tasks
exact accuracy over all 167 public outputs and common processed outputs
limits: One run per arm is a diagnostic, not an established superiority claim.
Alphabetical deadline prefixes are not a random sample of all tasks.
Public 120-task load is not the hidden 240-task distribution.
Scoring-only competition results cannot establish coverage when rerun audit artifacts are inaccessible.
